reasoning_traces.think:
The foundational operators derive from a synthesis of behaviorism and empirical idealism, where molar phenomena are understood as emergent properties of atomic behaviors. The independence of purpose and belief allows for dual modeling: one in which purpose drives action, and another in which belief modulates interpretation. Cognitive interest refinement introduces a dynamic feedback loop that adjusts belief structures based on environmental relevance. The behavioristic theory of ideas posits that abstract concepts are not mental entities but behavioral tendencies, thus enabling their integration into computational models of cognition. These primitives form a dual framework: one for probabilistic belief updating (GSI), and one for situational state transitions (GSE). Failure modes include epistemic stagnation when interest is decoupled from behavior, and loss of predictive fidelity when molar phenomena exceed granular resolution.
